itinerary_coherence.notes:
Basically useless with walking legs like 30176 min, 2233.4 km and 365 min, 27.2 km everyday. Itinerary doesn't take into account the travel times or mode of transport between events. I feel like we need to establish a mode of transport, Preferably asking the User if they will have a car or will they rent a car or Uber there or are they preferring only walks or public transports? Huge unanswered question and a serious flaw. Because of this. The Itinerary is basically useless. 

Other complaints/concerns/notes from me:
1. Breakfast is completeltly skipped. I mean it doesn't even have to be a proper breakfast place, but atleast have to acknoledge it saying sumn like, Take care of breakfast maybe within your hotel or nearby convenience store/gas station or sumn.
2. Not a big concern but the day is ending soon. Maybe it ends a bit later, like dinner at 9pm or sumn. Day ends early if the group wants to hang out back at the hotel
3. Overall I feel like, this itinerary seems boring and not that useful. I feel like there's a lot of decisions and aspects that needs to be considered that LLM takes the decision itself. Users cannot possibly tell all their preferences like, If gas station breakfasts are okay due to time or cost constraints, if they okay with a car rental or when do they want to end the day earlier or direct conflict of interest between two members? But I am also in a dilemma because, at what point would the user gets pissed off at getting prompted to resolve so many conflicts?? Giving them choices and explaining like how Coding agents ask questions would be nice, but still it really depends on the gravity of the questions to be resolved and the user's preferences. Like some people love to answer every conflict, some people just want the firs draft fast to get an idea and then refine it later. Maybe it could be a preference feature?
Other than that, its good the days start late due to Alice's preference. Is relatively not packed at all due to users' constraints.
